title: iHeartMedia and Will Ferrell’s Big Money Players Welcome Viral Comedian Kyle Prue to the Network Debuting New Podcast “Get Worse with Kyle Prue”
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*The weekly podcast debuts October 6 with two episodes – series guests include comedians, content creators and actors including Hope Carew, Kel Cripe, Grant Gibbs, Sophia Sherman, Andrew Stier, Vinny Thomas and more*


**NEW YORK – September 29, 2026 –** iHeartMedia and Will Ferrell’s Big Money Players (BMP) today announced that actor, writer, creator and connoisseur of pissing off men, Kyle Prue, will join the network and debut his first podcast “Get Worse with Kyle Prue.” New episodes will be available weekly beginning October 6. Fans can check out the official trailer now,[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-get-worse-with-kyle-prue-346419703) .


Prue, who garnered a large following online with his viral series “How To Piss Off Men,” will host the audio-visual podcast. “[Get Worse with Kyle Prue](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-get-worse-with-kyle-prue-346419703) ” will be an “advice” show where the New York Times Best Selling Author will interview comedians, philosophers, criminals, experts, etc., and will respond to write-in advice questions. Is the advice any good? Never intentionally.


“I am so excited to be the first person to ever start a podcast. I can think of no better home for ‘Get Worse’ than Big Money Players and no better proverbial stepfather to my show than Will Ferrell. I’d like to thank my team, producers and psychiatrist.”


In the first episode, Prue will sit down with comedians Hope Carew and Andrew Stier to answer listener questions and explore topics ranging from spreading the gay agenda through football and Thanksgiving nudism to how best to blackmail coworkers. Also dropping on October 6, episode two will feature actor, writer and comedian Sophia Sherman and special guest Count Dracula discussing 400 years of dating and situationships. Occasionally chiming in with “advice” and joining Prue on camera for offbeat adventures throughout the series will be his co-producers Max Michalsky and Aaron Klein. Additional guests will include comedians, actors and content creators including Kel Cripe, Grant Gibbs, Vinny Thomas and more.


“We are excited to have Kyle join us on our Big Money Players Network. Whether through his viral content, bestselling writing or now podcasting, Kyle has consistently found creative ways to connect with audiences,” said Will Pearson, President of iHeartPodcasts. "‘Get Worse’ showcases the comedy that has made him a standout voice online, and we can’t wait for listeners to experience that same energy, spontaneity and laughter on his weekly podcast.”


Founded by Will Ferrell and iHeartMedia, the[Big Money Players Network](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/category/bigmoneyplayers-218/) is the premiere destination for comedy podcasts and home to top comedic talent across a variety of formats and styles – both scripted and unscripted. In addition to audio’s No. 1 comedy “The Ron Burgundy Podcast,” BMP features long-running hits like “Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang,” “Thanks Dad with Ego Nwodim,” “Hollywood Handbook,” “Straightiolab” and more. All BMP podcasts are executive produced by Will Ferrell and iHeartMedia and are distributed by iHeartPodcasts. See the full catalog[here.](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/category/bigmoneyplayers-218/)


New episodes of “[Get Worse with Kyle Prue](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-get-worse-with-kyle-prue-346419703) ” will air every Tuesday on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard. Video episodes will also be available on iHeart and[YouTube](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DVjr9c4o9AKE&data=05%7C02%7CAlfredWarren%40iheartmedia.com%7C255bc66b13304d796cc708df1e2c4399%7C122a527e5b714eba878d9810b495b9e3%7C0%7C0%7C639262847612283575%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=DcrZBegP%2FFXPywcKF7Sl7myB1nJziDc6BHby7rGrkEk%3D&reserved=0) . Fans can follow @getworsepodcast on Instagram, Facebook and YouTube or @getworsepod on TikTok for updates and special content.


**About Kyle Prue**


Kyle Prue is an award-winning author, actor and comedian known for his deadpan wit and provocative storytelling. Kyle gained widespread acclaim with the viral series “How To Piss Off Men,” which has amassed hundreds of millions of views across social media. The series culminated in a handbook that debuted as an instant New York Times Bestseller. In addition, Kyle Prue is the author of the award-winning Feud Trilogy – the young adult fantasy novel series – and the creative force behind the cult favorite web-series, Rabbit.
